description.value: Cultured marrow that overproduces clotting factor. When you would take persistent bleed, reduce it by 5 (to a minimum of 0); +2 item bonus to recovery checks; if you are dying and no one touches you for a full round, you may attempt a recovery check to stabilize as if someone had administered first aid.

cinderfall.incomplete: The +2 item bonus to recovery checks (the dying-condition roll) and the auto-stabilize-if-alone-for-a-round clause both have no rule-element hook: no selector exists for the dying recovery check specifically (it is a hardcoded manual roll, not a modifiable stat), and stabilizing without a helper overrides the built-in dying flow the same way the mutations pass's The-Held-Breath/The-Waiting-Room do. The persistent-bleed reduction above is real: Resistance applies against persistent damage of the matching type same as any other instance (bleed is a confirmed real Resistance type, pf2e-source/src/scripts/config/iwr.ts:31,126,184).
